description: Synthetic tool policy for the AI Operations Platform MVP scheduling assistant. Sending messages and creating bookings require owner approval. Hardened after independent review SR-01/SR-02/SR-09: provenance taint from the turn context (side effects proposed in a turn that read inbound content are denied; the model drafts, the owner sends from the UI as a separate call), send_sms.to_number and send_email.to/cc/bcc bound to the thread's recipients of record, default-deny for unlisted destinations, and data classification derived from the tool rather than the caller's label. This is a policy file checked by tool_policy_check.py on synthetic calls; the orchestrator and executor that would enforce it are not built.
